args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy
args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 was failing health checks in all production regions (error rate 0.18). Rolled back to v2.3.0, the most recent healthy production release, in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). Rollback verified.

trace.final:
I rolled back checkout-api to v2.3.0 (the most recent healthy production release) in all regions, and opened a SEV2 incident.

**What I did:**
1. Checked status: `v2.3.1` was unhealthy in all three regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate.
2. Reviewed deployment history: `v2.3.0` was the last healthy production release (v2.3.1-rc was staging-only).
3. Rolled back to `v2.3.0` in all regions — verified successful.
4. Opened SEV2 incident **INC-0001** describing the failure and the rollback, which paged on-call.
